component.name: Shoebill Text Editor
component.summary: Simple, fast text and code editor

description.p: Shoebill is a fast, lightweight text and code editor with tabs, syntax colors for more than 300 languages, powerful search and replace, multiple cursors, split view and themes.
The editing features are free. Shoebill Pro adds macros, running other programs, your own language definitions and changing shortcuts. A free preview key from the website unlocks Pro for 30 days.

A new icon with the Shoebill mascot, and more menu categories (Utility, Development and Office). Spelling dictionaries are now checked against fixed fingerprints. In a Flatpak sandbox the program no longer offers file type settings it cannot apply, and it explains what the sandbox means for Run and the code formatters.
